facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's mid-term review of the Kenya Health Sector Strategic and Investment Plan 2018-2023 states that the sector uses KHIS as its uniform platform for aggregate information and that the plan carries targets for facility reporting in it (90% at mid-term, 2020/21).

The Ministry of Health's mid-term review reports that the proportion of health facilities submitting reports within KHIS rose from 89% at baseline (2017/18) to 94% at mid-term (2019/20) against a target of 90%, with 12 counties below 90% and Isiolo lowest at 79%, and that integration of the Kenya Health Master Facility List with KHIS was completed in the period; this is a reporting rate over four summary forms, not a count of facilities keying their own data.

The Ministry of Health's mid-term review states that the 2018-2023 strategic plan makes electronic health records a monitored area, and that 53% of counties had electronic health records in at least one health facility in 2019/20 against a mid-term target of 48%; it adds that county reports did not enumerate the facilities using EMR and that no minimum definition of EMR was set.
